item.text: {"summary":"The draft is publishable on the target contract with only minor tightening needed around first-print wording and historical-context completeness.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The rule says both \"on 2027-10-22 fetch\" and \"Use the first registered query snapshot,\" which could read as conflicting if an earlier snapshot appears within the 2027-10-15 to 2027-10-22 window.","actionRequested":"Clarify that the resolving observation is the first successful registered-query snapshot captured under the target process, with resolutionDate fixed at 2027-10-22 as the ledger deadline."},{"rubricItem":"coherence","severity":"warning","summary":"The reasoning uses FY2016-FY2025 as the historical sample, but the JSON historicalContext field only includes FY2023-FY2025.","actionRequested":"Either include the full FY2016-FY2025 registered-query history in historicalContext or state that historicalContext is intentionally abbreviated while sourceContext and reasoning carry the full sample."}],"optionalSuggestions":["The Prior/update/interval step is strong; keep the explicit sigma, sqrt(2) horizon widening, and implied bounds.","Tail scenarios are concrete enough, but mentioning that NDAA enactment does not guarantee appropriations timing would make the downside tail sharper."]}
